methodology.derivedFrom: src/styles/dash.css. Every reviewed pair is resolved through its var() chain per theme and its contrast ratio computed with the WCAG 2.1 sRGB relative-luminance formula.
methodology.enforcement: `npm run accessibility` recomputes these on every push and fails the build below the stated threshold, then audits every built page for structural facts. This report is the same measurement, published.
methodology.driftRule: Generation fails when a reviewed pair names a token the stylesheet no longer defines, when a theme block disappears, or when the stylesheet uses a token it never defines.

measurements.name: body text on a raised surface
secondary text on a raised surface
body text on an accent tint
form control border on the page
form control border on a raised surface
decorative grouping rule
measurements.criterion: No WCAG threshold applies; this floor is a house rule so the line stays visible

notTested.checked: Every page has a language, one h1, a main landmark, labelled form controls, named buttons, discernible link text, and scoped table headers.
notTested.notChecked: Whether a page actually reads well. Correct structure is necessary and not sufficient: a heading can be present and unhelpful, and an alt text can exist and describe the wrong thing.

notTested.checked: Interactive controls are real buttons, links, inputs, and details elements, which are focusable and operable by keyboard by default.
notTested.notChecked: Focus order and focus visibility have not been walked page by page. Nothing here traps focus deliberately, but that is a claim about intent, not a measurement.

notTested.checked: Every image and recording carries alt text, and heavy recordings are deferred so they never block a page from appearing.
notTested.notChecked: The recordings have no captions or transcripts. They are silent screen captures of Dash, and the surrounding prose is written to stand on its own, but a reader who cannot see them is relying on that prose rather than on an equivalent.

notTested.checked: Browser tests assert that no reference page scrolls sideways at a 390 pixel viewport, which is the failure that wide generated tables cause.
notTested.notChecked: WCAG 1.4.10 reflow at 400 percent zoom, and 1.4.12 text spacing overrides, have not been measured.

notTested.checked: Contrast ratios for every reviewed pair, in both themes, computed from the stylesheet rather than asserted.
notTested.notChecked: Whether any status is carried by hue alone has been reviewed by eye rather than by tooling. Where colour appears in generated tables it is paired with text.

notTested.checked: The site is Starlight, whose own components are audited upstream, and the search index is Pagefind.
notTested.notChecked: Neither is re-audited here. A defect in the theme or in the search widget would not be caught by these checks.
